text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—Now then,
moving on to the overseas study program we
discussed the other day.
I will now announce the selected
participants.

An overseas program reserved only for the
most exceptional performers...
It had nothing to do with me.
...Even knowing that full well,
I found myself getting restless.
choice_data_list: (No, no, I'm just an ordinary pers...

text_block_list.text:
—In a moment like this,
would she believe without a shred of doubt
that she was chosen...?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—That's the five of you.
Those whose names were called,
report to the faculty office later.
Alright, meeting adjourned.

Just as expected, my name wasn't called.
I knew it was coming... and yet,
I found myself hurrying away from the room
as if trying to escape...

I'm not special.
I thought I'd accepted that long ago,
and yet...
choice_data_list: (Why does it hurt so much now—?)

text_block_list.text:
............
You too are locked in battle against some
trial, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You wear a troubled expression.
Do you stand in need of the Holy Maiden's
power?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Nay, you cannot deceive the eyes of the Holy
Maiden.
Your gaze is steeped in sorrow.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...I know that look.
It is the spitting image of my own younger
self.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Heh... If you care not to speak of it,
so be it.
In exchange, if you will indulge me,
allow me to share a tale with you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This is the chronicle of a certain girl
before her awakening...
A universal myth rooted deep within every
soul—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Once upon a time, in a certain place,
there lived a dearly beloved Umamusume
girl.
Praised for everything she did,
she truly believed she was special.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Above all,
her talent for racing was extraordinary,
enough to leave adults in sheer awe.
Filled with confidence,
the girl set off on the path of racing.
However...

text_block_list.name: Coach
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire, right?
Your entrance test scores were pretty
decent!
I'm so glad we've got another promising kid
joining us!

text_block_list.name: Young Desire
text_block_list.text:
('Pretty decent'? 'Another' kid...?
What are you talking about?
As if there could ever be someone else like
me!)

text_block_list.name: Young Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Hmph,
fine then.
Just watch me take first place and—
H-Huh...? Everyone's... so... fast...!)

text_block_list.name: Young Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! I am... amazing, darn it...! 
...Eek?! Ow, ow, ow...! That hurts...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Tragically,
the girl took a fall and was injured.
Even after she healed,
due to a delicate constitution she often
suffered stomach troubles,
and by the time she finally returned...

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
Hey, who's that girl? Was she always here?
No clue. Anyway,
did you hear?!
Senpai's aiming for Tracen Academy—!

text_block_list.name: Young Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh.
I'm amazing too, you know...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed...
The world of racing,
where she was meant to shine the brightest,
proved to be a path of thorns.

...I was surprised.
She had already tasted that pain herself.
The agonizing sting of learning that you
aren't 'special'...
choice_data_list: Even after that... why do you...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask...? It is simple.
Because I am still special regardless.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My light shall not be clouded by trifles
such as this.
For no matter how many times I nearly lose
sight of it,
it resides undeniably deep within my
heart.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I am a singular,
incomparable being unlike anyone else.
The Holy Maiden bearing a special destiny,
Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, precisely.
Just as light breaks every morning,
and an apple falls to the earth. ...To me,
it is a self-evident truth that requires no
second thought.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: The one and only me exists right here.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—The young girl continued to believe that
as well.
On and on, forever and ever...

text_block_list.name: Young Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Something's wrong...
I'm a special Umamusume.
That's it...
It's this world that's wrong...!)

text_block_list.name: Young Desire
text_block_list.text:
There must be an answer somewhere...!
History, sociology, foreign lands,
mythology... Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Young Desire
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? What pretty artwork...
'The Running Holy Maiden's Reincarnation in
Another World'?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—It was an absolute revelation.
After all, within that book,
my own story was written.

text_block_list.name: Young Desire
text_block_list.text:
I see...
Beyond these trials lies a world where I
can shine even brighter...
Because it's my destiny,
that's why the path of racing is so
grueling...!

text_block_list.name: Young Desire
text_block_list.text:
The world was granting me trials to
overcome!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Awakening to the truth,
the girl recognized herself as the 'Holy
Maiden,'
and began her journey toward that distant
other world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trials came one after another.
With every one she overcame,
the Holy Maiden's radiance grew...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And in search of even greater trials,
she made her way to Tracen Academy—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Finally... I have finally made it here!
Gathering celestial radiance,
I will reach that other world without
fail!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ————And thus, the Holy Maiden descended.

...It seems I had misunderstood her.
I had assumed she could keep chasing
her dreams only because she hadn't tasted
setback yet.

What she possessed was a child's pure desire
for recognition.
Yet pushed to such an absolute extreme—
it was almost refreshing.
choice_data_list: If only I could see things that wa...
If only I could look at things lik...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Did I not say? This is a universal myth.
A primal memory held by all.
If it is a jewel sealed away deep within
your heart,
you need only summon it forth once more.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Have you truly never considered yourself to
be special?

She gazed at me in silence.
Her earnest words struck straight to my heart,
and a voice forced its way out of my
throat.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: There lies your answer, troubled soul.

Why did that strike such a chord with me?
Could it be that, even now...
choice_data_list: (Do I still want to believe? In my...
(Could I still want to believe? In...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I bestow upon you the Holy Maiden's
blessing.
A blessing that will allow you to believe
in yourself once more...

—The next morning,
I felt remarkably refreshed.
Perhaps having those buried feelings drawn
out had lifted a weight off my chest.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll... give it my all again.
Maybe I should... give it my all too.

text_block_list.text:
Maybe there's no reason to give up on myself
just yet...
With that thought in mind,
I began tackling the work before me with
everything I had.

Whether I'm truly 'ordinary' or not remains
to be seen.
No matter how many times I stumble,
maybe one day I can find my own
brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, I've got a job I'd like you to handle,
got some free time?
It's a special remedial session for a rather
restless girl...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I knew you'd say that!
You've been working exceptionally hard lately,
after all.

Was this chance coming my way because I'd
worked hard following Red Desire's
example?
It felt like an opportunity had fallen right
into my lap.
Time to do my best and believe in myself—!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—Man,
leaving it to you was definitely the right
call! You really saved me.
That was truly an impressive,
commanding display of coaching!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way...
a spot opened up for that overseas training
program. How about it?
You seem to have found your confidence,
and with this kind of work,
you're more than qualified!

Stepping out into the breeze with a sense
of accomplishment,
I spotted a familiar figure.
No, she carried an air so divine...
it was an eye-opening sight.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You have attained your brilliance, I see.
Having overcome countless trials...
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to the Holy Maiden...
It's all thanks to the Holy Maiden...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
The power that awakened within you was your
own.
Holy Maiden Desire merely bestowed a blessing
upon you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The Holy Maiden watched over you from afar,
bearing witness to it all.
To all your hard work...!
